description: This Kotlin source file defines an object 'CartIdentityPrompter' that provides a method to prompt the user for an email, used as a cart identity, via a dialog. It encapsulates UI interactions related to inputting and saving an email address within the shopping platform.

classes.name: CartIdentityPrompter
classes.description: A singleton object that provides UI functionality to prompt the user for their email address for cart identification purposes.

methods.name: promptForEmail
methods.description: Displays a dialog prompting the user to input their email, with options to cancel or save. When saved, invokes a callback with the entered email.
